primitives.name: Possession Transition Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: The location of players in the field of view of broadcast camera allows one to innovate and build new performance evaluation metrics.
primitives.latex: T_{ij}(t) = \mathbb{P}(\text{player } i \text{ transitions to } j \mid t)
primitives.assumptions: Transition probabilities are Markovian over short time intervals; player locations are known.
